beforeWholeGoal.title: Datenvalidität, Fehlerquellen und Modellgrenzen reflektieren
beforeWholeGoal.titleEn: Reflect Data Validity, Error Sources, and Model Limits
beforeWholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann eigene Ergebnisse und den Erkenntnisprozess reflektieren, indem sie die Gültigkeit von Daten beurteilt, Fehlerquellen ermittelt und Möglichkeiten sowie Grenzen von Modellen diskutiert.
beforeWholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can reflect on results and inquiry processes by judging data validity, identifying error sources, and discussing possibilities and limits of models.

candidateWholeGoal.title: Datenvalidität, Fehlerquellen und Modellgrenzen reflektieren
candidateWholeGoal.titleEn: Reflect Data Validity, Error Sources, and Model Limits
candidateWholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann eigene Ergebnisse und den Erkenntnisprozess reflektieren, indem sie die Gültigkeit von Daten beurteilt, Fehlerquellen ermittelt und Möglichkeiten sowie Grenzen von Modellen diskutiert.
candidateWholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can reflect on their own results and their own inquiry process by judging data validity, identifying error sources, and discussing possibilities and limits of models.

semanticKindReason: This is an assessable subject competency whose content is critical reflection on own biological inquiry, with data-validity, errors and model limits as connected criteria. It is neither motivational orientation nor an assessment endpoint or recall goal. Adding own in EN restores the already binding DE and BY own-results/process scope.

atomicityRecord.reason: One assessable inquiry-reflection routine: assess validity of own recorded results, diagnose measurement/classification or confounding errors, and evaluate the model assumptions used in that same inquiry. The exact EN own-results/own-inquiry repair restores the DE and official BY obligation, without adding a separate independently mastered topic or changing graph/source scope.

memoryRecord.reason: Calibration validity, own-process error diagnosis and model-boundary revision require applying relationships to the actual inquiry record. Recall of isolated definitions or a fixed correction is insufficient evidence; mandatory cards/SRS are not required for this goal. The EN fidelity repair changes neither this judgment nor the needed reasoning.
